title: Add governed memory create and update tools to shared chat tool catalog
description: Vetted from Audit #7 finding 2.1. Shared tool surface lacks first-class memory mutation tools while tasks/pages have mutation flows. Add proposal/governance-aligned memory create/update tool descriptors and enforce AgentWritesEnabled plus approval mode constraints. Align with MCP exposure defaults and existing write-risk policy.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from vetted findings in Data/Pages/move-to-audit.md after direct code checks across Chat.razor, ChatServices.cs, ChatToolCatalog.cs, McpController.cs, and training harness files.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Completed governed memory mutation tools in shared catalog. Added memorysmith_memory_create and memorysmith_memory_update descriptors with write-risk classification, Agent-only availability in chat mode, MCP default-off exposure, and explicit AgentWritesEnabled + auto_accept approval-mode enforcement in tool delegates. Wired approval context into both chat and MCP tool execution contexts. Added focused coverage in ChatToolCatalogAndInterceptTests and McpAndSemanticSearchTests for tool exposure/default-off and governance blocking behavior. Validation: dotnet test MemorySmith.Tests/MemorySmith.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter "Name~ChatToolCatalog_ExposesWriteToolsOnlyToAgentMode|Name~ChatToolCatalog_DefaultsSensitiveAndWriteMcpToolsOff|Name~MemoryMutationTools_RequireAgentWritesAndAutoAcceptMode|Name~MemoryMutationTools_CreateAndUpdateMemoryRecordInAutoAcceptMode|Name~McpSafeDefaults_HideSensitiveAndWriteToolsUntilExplicitlyEnabled|Name~McpMemoryMutationTools_RequireAutoAcceptApprovalMode".
